headline: Has Hungary's Big Housing Price Explosion Arrived? The Moment Thousands of Buyers Have Been Waiting For Is Here
summary: Nationwide home prices rose 0.6% month on month in August, while Budapest prices fell 0.1%. Annual growth slowed to 11.5% nationally and 6.7% in Budapest.
why: House prices influence mortgage lending, household wealth and construction activity, and they feed into central bank assessments of financial stability.
